objectives.en: Say every fact from seven times one to seven times twelve without help.
objectives.yo: Sọ gbogbo fact láti seven times one dé seven times twelve láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́.
objectives.pcm: Talk every fact from seven times one reach seven times twelve without help.

objectives.en: Answer any seven times fact out of order.
objectives.yo: Dáhùn èyíkéyìí seven times fact láìtẹ̀lé ètò.
objectives.pcm: Answer any seven times fact wey no follow order.

curriculum.objective: Multiply whole numbers 1 x 1 up to 9 x 9, using a 10 by 10 square chart
curriculum.note: No scheme subdivides the 1x1 to 9x9 block by table; only the term is supported.

say.en: Look at three groups of seven mangoes. Today we count in sevens.
say.pcm: Look three groups of seven mango. Today we go count seven seven.
say.yo: Wo groups three ti seven mango. Lónìí a ó kà ní seven seven.

say.en: Today you will learn the seven times table. Then you will say it by yourself.
say.pcm: Today you go learn table seven. Then you go talk am by yourself.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò kọ́ table seven. Lẹ́yìn náà, ìwọ yóò sọ ọ́ fúnra rẹ.

say.en: Do you remember the six times table? What is six times seven?
say.pcm: You remember table six? Six times seven na how much?
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí table six? Kí ni six times seven?

say.en: Three groups of seven mangoes show this. We count seven, fourteen, twenty-one. Seven times three is twenty-one.
say.pcm: See three groups of seven mango: seven, fourteen, twenty-one. Seven times three na twenty-one.
say.yo: Wo groups mẹ́ta ti seven mango: seven, fourteen, twenty-one. Seven times three jẹ́ twenty-one.

say.en: Say it with me: seven times three is twenty-one.
say.pcm: Say am with me: seven times three na twenty-one.
say.yo: Sọ ọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ mi: seven times three jẹ́ twenty-one.

say.en: Say the seven times table. Start with seven times one. End with seven times twelve.
say.pcm: Say table seven. Start with seven times one. End with seven times twelve.
say.yo: Sọ table seven. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú seven times one. Parí pẹ̀lú seven times twelve.

say.en: Let us fix the ones you missed. Listen, then say them with me.
say.pcm: Make we fix the ones you miss. Hear them, then say them with me.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn tí o pàdánù ṣe. Gbọ́, lẹ́yìn náà sọ wọ́n pọ̀ mọ́ mi.

say.pcm: Seven times seven na how much?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we check the seven times table once more. Then we start the eight times table.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go check table seven again. Then we start table eight.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ṣàyẹ̀wò table seven. Lẹ́yìn náà a ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ table eight.
